entities.name: Endonuclease IV (B2A499)
observations: Reviewed UniProt B2A499 is an exact sequence match (100% identity and coverage); annotated as probable endonuclease IV, EC 3.1.21.2.
Endonuclease IV cleaves DNA phosphodiester bonds at apurinic/apyrimidinic sites, producing a 3′-hydroxyl and a 5′-terminal sugar phosphate.
Binds three Zn2+ ions according to the reference annotation.

entities.name: AP-site DNA incision
observations: Endonucleolytic cleavage of the phosphodiester bond at an apurinic or apyrimidinic DNA site yields a DNA strand with a 3′-OH terminus and a 5′-terminal sugar phosphate; EC 3.1.21.2.

entities.name: Zn2+ (CHEBI:29105)
observations: Reference annotation reports that endonuclease IV binds three Zn2+ ions.
